decisions.reason: The candidate already contains a complete same-message MODIFY recording that the battery must remain pluggable in the mounted orientation; no additional or corrected Event is needed.
Maintaining battery-plug access in a mounted orientation does not change the established three-board architecture.
The source concerns physical access to the battery connector, not battery electrical, thermal, overcharge, or overdischarge protection.
Battery connector accessibility does not alter ESP32 clock, sleep, deep-sleep, or wake behavior.
The mechanical battery-access constraint does not change charge-status indication through the main-board SK6812 LED chain.
The source does not change the software-switched 5V rail, its enable control, or its sensor-power purpose.
The source establishes a mounted-access constraint but does not change connector sourceability, availability, or compatible-alternative policies.
Battery connector accessibility has no entailed effect on I2C cable length, speed, pull-up resistance, or pull-up location.
